test_title: PYST 66: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, J, K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting in a straight row, facing north. J sits fourth to the left of N. O sits third to the right of J. M sits fourth to the left of O. Only three people sit between P and L. No one sits to the left of L. Who sits at the second position from the right end of the row?
solution:
Seven people, J, K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of L.

2) Only three people sit between P and L.
